description: Android service class that listens for data changes to trigger or stop an alarm sound, managing media playback and volume levels.

classes.name: SoundAlarmListenerService
classes.description: Android WearableListenerService subclass that handles alarm sound playback based on data change events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes AudioManager, MediaPlayer, and alarm sound URI, and stores original volume.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Resets alarm volume to original and releases MediaPlayer resources.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events to start or stop alarm sound, adjusting volume and media playback accordingly.
